sloka: माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा सम्ताप कर्शिता ।धर्मम् एव अग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानम् अर्हति ॥२-२६-३१॥
transliteration: mātā ca mama kausalyā vṛddhā samtāpa karśitā ।dharmam eva agrataḥ kṛtvā tvattaḥ sammānam arhati ॥2-26-31॥

translations.english: You should give importance to duty(dharma) and show respect to my aged mother who is emaciated due to grief.
